sam: Quick sizing q — bringup plan for the new 30B q4f16 run. Thinking a Dedicated pool split across us-west and eu-west. Target p99 latency ~220ms for h100, ~350ms for a100. Anyone run region-pair sims recently?
elaine: ran a micro-bench last week. h100 p50 ~90ms p99 ~210ms at conc=8/card (batch=1). a100 p99 jumps when conc >4.
jordan: can you paste the perf matrix? link to the sheet would help.
sam: small inline table from local run:
```
region | gpu  | conc/card | p50   | p99   | tput
us-west | h100 | 8         | 90ms  | 210ms | 120 qps
us-west | a100 | 4         | 130ms | 360ms | 60 qps
eu-west | h100 | 6         | 95ms  | 230ms | 100 qps
```
kavita: do those figures include kernel-fallback cases? we saw a ~40ms delta when fused-attn fell back on longer seqs.
derek: kernel note — fused-attn path on h100, cuBLAS/robust-fallback on a100 for q4f16. quant path is mixed; 8-bit matmul path spikes memory pressure on some instances. ops-bot: FYI capacity-bot scheduled sims at 08:00 PST.
capacity-bot: Auto-sim summary (fast pass): baseline pool 10 h100 (us-west) -> sustained 12k q/day, 95th concurrency headroom ~2 gpus. Suggest reserve +2 cards for night bursts.
elaine: for Dedicated sizing I'd recommend per-region safety margin 25% if cross-region failover is enabled, otherwise 40% for single-region SLA.
sam: proposed draft: us-west h100 pool = 12 cards (8 base + 4 headroom) target conc/card = 6; eu-west h100 pool = 8 cards. keep a100 as cheaper burst fallback: 6 cards in us-west.
kavita: adding autoscale config snippet to the proposal:
```
autoscale:
  min: 6
  target_concurrency_per_gpu: 6
  scale_up_policy: immediate
  scale_down_delay: 10m
```
sam: can we run a sensitivity sim skewing seq length distribution to 1024 (worst-case) and an inter-region outage test (cold-start failover)?
derek: I'll run that tomorrow — expect ~15% higher p99 during outage due to cold KV warming. will post numbers.
jordan: also add an eval hook to monitor quality regressions after we switch quant kernels. don't want perf wins that degrade LM behavior.
sam: SG. @derek @kavita can you coordinate infra job + canary config? target to have numbers and a short ops runbook by Fri.
kavita: will queue infra job and add canary policy to rollout.
derek: queued -> job#8421. will post summary when done.
sam: thanks :thumbsup:
